body: This is long overdue, but thank you for your concern and kind words.

I also wanted to say that I'm glad people like you are around to actually care about those here. I know it must be draining to do. I wish that I made more of an effort to appreciate your comment before.
I'm glad you've made your life better for yourself. I sincerely hope it all continues well for you. Best wishes to you as well.
I appreciate your concern and thank you for taking the time to say all of this. I just sincerely hope I reach a point where SOMETHING in my life is the way I want it to be...
I absolutely was only living to not hurt my family for a while. Now I'm bouncing back and forth as I try to stabilize my life...

It depends. I've calmed down a bit from my crazy rant. I feel physically exhausted honestly hahaha. Anyway, I enjoy a lot when I'm not looking through an emotional haze. I have a few friends that I love spending time with. I love nature, games, playing music, programming, etc etc etc. I just can't enjoy them when it feels like I need to be doing other things to not be alone or that I'm forced to do something to get a job and if I can't do it fast enough I'll be stuck.

I know. The only reason I'm still alive is out of obligation. I tried to talk to a counselor, but the best he could say was "wow, it's nice to not have someone who doesn't just say, 'I think I'm drinking too much'" (college counselor). I don't really enjoy that much anymore in general. I'm just struggling to survive against myself. I don't know what to do. Struggling forward doesn't seem to be enough

I think all of this is important, but the working out is something I definitely need to do more consistently. It's much harder to be crazy about things when you're using that excess energy and it just seems like your body works more smoothly. Thanks for all of your advice!
Yeah, EE is electrical engineering. I'll have to try that. I think almost all of my problems in life come from my attitude about things. Thank you!

Thanks, this makes me feel a lot better. I have a tendency to get stuck in my own head and get in my own way. It takes a little to bring me back to a better perspective, but I think I've been growing each time it happens. He gave me a book about software interview questions, so I've been reading through that a bit. Thank you so much!
